corn-yield-predictor.label: Trend corn yield, 2026
corn-yield-predictor.headline: 206 bu/acre
corn-yield-predictor.detail: Cass County, IA yields since 2000 rise about 2.5 bu/acre a year. In 1 year in 10 the county falls below 185.
corn-yield-predictor.source: USDA NASS county corn yields (all practices), 2000 on
corn-yield-predictor.method: Straight-line trend through the county's yields; the low end is the 10th percentile of each year's yield relative to its trend. County averages, not a forecast of this season.

farm-equipment-planner.label: Fall field days, Oct 1 to Nov 30
farm-equipment-planner.headline: 48 of 61 days
farm-equipment-planner.detail: Cass County, IA: workable days in a typical fall since 2000; in a wet fall (1 in 10) about 43. Wettest: 2017, with 42. Counts rain only, not snow or frozen ground.
farm-equipment-planner.source: NASA POWER daily rainfall, 2000 on (via the Yield Predictor)
farm-equipment-planner.method: Workable day = under 2.5 mm of rain that day and under 12.5 mm over the two days before. Typical = median fall; wet = 10th percentile.
